collection.description: A child falls and the arm heals poorly unless the healers attempt to straighten and support it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A child falls and the arm heals poorly unless the healers attempt to straighten and support it.

choices.label: Support the arm without moving it.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The arm gradually heals in a better position, though movement remains painful.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The attempt worsens the injury, and the healers must change their plan.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The child heals with a lasting bend but learns to use the arm well.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The pain continues, and the family asks whether more treatment is possible.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The healers disagree, and the family requests time to decide.

c1__fx.name: Outcome C1
c1__fx.text: A second healer suggests a gentler support that improves comfort.
